rules.limitations: Use the complete native inert-material sanitary-landfill service for the inspected cement-like inert waste. All 42 declared wet-composition entries match the source; both declare zero overall degradability. The 0%-water product labels and source product properties are not a reason to renormalize the shared wet-composition inventory. Source reference -1 kg and native reference +1 kg require factor -1, preserving signed as-received kg without moisture, dry-mass, density, capacity or lifetime scaling. Retain sanitary base sealing, leachate collection/treatment, landfill operations, infrastructure, auxiliary waste handling and long-term groundwater releases; do not use the old 5%-water construction/inert-landfill endpoint. Twenty-one nominal releases match publisher ID, receiving compartment, unit and amount. The source manganese release has the same signed mass and long-term groundwater compartment but the imported native2026 inventory uses a different generic-manganese identifier/species label; retain that native biosphere difference with no molecular or CF-equivalence claim. Native additional waste heat, complete boiler/energy supply, auxiliary paper/plastic disposal, internal freight, background allocation and vintage differ. The complete Swiss service represents the inspected CH3.6 case and is a geographic proxy for Europe-without-Switzerland3.9. Separate caller collection, processing, formulas, uncertainty and emissions remain unchanged. No added carbon, heat, metal or recovery credit is inferred. Inventory and LCIA equality are not established; score effects are unquantified. Only the enumerated exact cut-off profiles are reviewed; other profiles and inferred inverse/cross-model routes remain unresolved.
